integrity: The proof partitions by the center label. A leaf-support argument forces every middle arm vertex to be positive. Center labels zero and one force arm costs at least three, while center label two yields arm cost at least two and requires at least one three-unit arm. Equality then forces exactly one exceptional arm and determines its two possible states. A standalone definition-level checker exhausts all labelings for q=2,3,4 and independently checks the constructed family through q=50.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to stars with every edge subdivided exactly twice and at least three arms.
The two-arm boundary has additional minimum-function types.
No formula is claimed for nonuniform spiders or for three or more uniform subdivisions.
Exhaustive computation is performed only for q=2,3,4; the arbitrary-order result is proved symbolically.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed treatment of the exact repeated-subdivision family.
title: Total perfect Roman domination of twice-subdivided stars
